chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Abu Abdullah, from Musa ibn al-Qasim, from Abu Jameela, from Durays who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Allah has given you this surplus from the wealth so that you may direct it where Allah directs it, and He did not give it to you so that you may hoard it.'
ai.seo_question: What is the proper purpose of surplus wealth according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that surplus wealth is a trust (amanah) intended for active circulation in accordance with divine will, rather than static hoarding (kanz). This teaching underscores the Shia ethical principle that wealth must be utilized for social welfare and obedience to God, linking material abundance directly to spiritual accountability and the proper channeling of resources for communal benefit.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Musa Bin Al Qasim, from Abu Jameela, from Zureys who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But rather, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Given you this extra from the wealth in order for you to divert it where Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Wants it to be diverted to, and He<sup>azwj</sup> did not Give these to you in order for you to be hoarding it’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from Musa ibn al-Qasim from abu Jamilah from Durays who has said the following: “I heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, say, ‘
Allah has granted you the extra wealth so that you spend it the way Allah wants you to spend. He has not given you this to keep for safe keeping.’”
